# AxolotyZenohCore ESP-IDF component. It compiles the portable Zenoh session
# types from the locked Core checkout in place and exports the module for the
# selected Zenoh transport. Portable source is never copied here.
#
# The Swift sources import AxolotyWire and the Core-owned CAxolotyZenoh facade
# module. The facade module map is generated by Core's preparation tool and
# named by the preparation report; this component passes it to the Swift
# frontend exactly as Tests/embedded/run-zenoh-host-test.sh does on the host.
# The facade declarations resolve to the backend the selected transport links.

include("${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/../../cmake/axoloty-source.cmake")

# ESP-IDF walks every directory under components/ during its requirements
# pass, including components no profile selected. A component that fails
# closed there fails every other profile's build too. So fail closed only
# when this transport is the selected one. Unselected, the component
# registers empty and contributes nothing. See docs/container-builds.md.
if(NOT DEFINED AXOLOTY_TRANSPORT_DIR OR "${AXOLOTY_TRANSPORT_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    if(DEFINED ENV{AXOLOTY_TRANSPORT_DIR})
        set(AXOLOTY_TRANSPORT_DIR "$ENV{AXOLOTY_TRANSPORT_DIR}")
    endif()
endif()
get_filename_component(AXOLOTY_SELECTED_TRANSPORT "${AXOLOTY_TRANSPORT_DIR}" NAME)
if(NOT AXOLOTY_SELECTED_TRANSPORT STREQUAL "zenoh-pico")
    idf_component_register()
    return()
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCE_DIR OR "${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCE_DIR}" STREQUAL "")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "the Core preparation report has no zenohCore sourceDir; the Zenoh "
        "transport needs AxolotyZenohCore from a Core revision that publishes "
        "it (phynics/axoloty#974)"
    )
endif()

file(GLOB AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCES
    "${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCE_DIR}/*.swift"
)

if(NOT AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCES)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "No AxolotyZenohCore sources found at ${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCE_DIR}")
endif()

if(NOT DEFINED AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_MAP OR "${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_MAP}" STREQUAL "")
    message(FATAL_ERROR
        "the Core preparation report names no Zenoh module map; without it "
        "the Swift import of CAxolotyZenoh would resolve against declarations "
        "the firmware image does not compile against"
    )
endif()
get_filename_component(AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_DIR
    "${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_MAP}" DIRECTORY
)

# Create an empty bridging header — AxolotyZenohCore needs no C bridge of its
# own. Its facade import arrives as the CAxolotyZenoh module named above.
# The idf_swift component requires a BRIDGING_HEADER.
file(WRITE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/empty_bridging_header.h "")

idf_component_register(
    SRCS "component_anchor.c"
    PRIV_REQUIRES idf_swift axoloty_wire json_core
)

idf_component_register_swift(
    ${COMPONENT_LIB}
    BRIDGING_HEADER ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/empty_bridging_header.h
    SRCS ${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCES}
)

# `idf_component_register_swift` resets COMPILE_OPTIONS to its Embedded
# target defaults, so declare the frontend module name and Core-generated
# facade map after it. These flags also ensure the public module interface
# passes the map to every Swift consumer loading AxolotyZenohCore.swiftmodule.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PRIVATE
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-swift-version>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:6>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-enable-experimental-feature>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:Lifetimes>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-module-name>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:AxolotyZenohCore>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-Xcc>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-fmodule-map-file=${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_MAP}>"
)

# The module imports AxolotyWire. Make the module alias a hard compile-time
# prerequisite, not only a link dependency, for clean parallel builds.
idf_component_get_property(WIRE_COMPONENT_LIB axoloty_wire COMPONENT_LIB)
get_target_property(WIRE_COMPONENT_BINARY_DIR ${WIRE_COMPONENT_LIB} BINARY_DIR)
set(WIRE_MODULE_ALIAS
    "${WIRE_COMPONENT_BINARY_DIR}/AxolotyWire.swiftmodule"
)
if(TARGET axoloty_wire_module_alias)
    add_dependencies(axoloty_wire_module_alias ${WIRE_COMPONENT_LIB})
    add_dependencies(${COMPONENT_LIB} axoloty_wire_module_alias)
endif()
set_source_files_properties(${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_SOURCES}
    PROPERTIES OBJECT_DEPENDS "${WIRE_MODULE_ALIAS}"
)
idf_component_get_property(JSON_CORE_COMPONENT_LIB json_core COMPONENT_LIB)
add_dependencies(${COMPONENT_LIB} ${JSON_CORE_COMPONENT_LIB})

# idf_swift adds the component bridge header as a public compile option.
# AxolotyZenohCore needs no C bridge, and exporting its empty header overrides
# the application bridge in dependent Swift compiles.
set_property(TARGET ${COMPONENT_LIB} PROPERTY INTERFACE_COMPILE_OPTIONS "")

# Override the Swift module name to AxolotyZenohCore (defaults to the CMake
# target name __idf_axoloty_zenoh_core otherwise). The facade module map binds
# the Core-owned C declarations to the CAxolotyZenoh import the sources use.
target_include_directories(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}
    ${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_INCLUDE_DIR}
    ${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_DIR}
)

# The Core module exposes CAxolotyZenoh in its public import graph. Its direct
# Swift compile receives the generated module map above; dependents also need
# the same map when they load AxolotyZenohCore.swiftmodule, plus the generated
# facade header's include directory for Clang to resolve it.
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} INTERFACE
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-Xcc>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-fmodule-map-file=${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_MAP}>"
)
target_compile_options(${COMPONENT_LIB} PUBLIC
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-Xcc>"
    "$<$<COMPILE_LANGUAGE:Swift>:-fmodule-map-file=${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_FACADE_MODULE_MAP}>"
)

# Publish the module under its importable name as an explicit build output, so
# the main component can order its Swift compile after this copy exists in a
# clean parallel build.
set(AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_MODULE_ALIAS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/AxolotyZenohCore.swiftmodule"
)
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT ${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_MODULE_ALIAS}
    COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E copy_if_different
        ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/${COMPONENT_LIB}.swiftmodule
        ${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_MODULE_ALIAS}
    DEPENDS ${COMPONENT_LIB}
    VERBATIM
)
add_custom_target(axoloty_zenoh_core_module_alias
    DEPENDS ${AXOLOTY_ZENOH_CORE_MODULE_ALIAS}
)
